verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents running as a CI job across supported CI providers, triggered on pull or merge request events, using the `semgrep ci` command. The evidence never addresses failing the build through exit codes or limiting the gate to new findings, so the blocking half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented exit-code behavior that fails the build on findings, diff-aware scanning that gates only new findings, independent hands-on corroboration of CI gating.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run scans in CI on every pull request and fail the build on new findings via exit codes

citations.quote: This guide walks you through creating a Semgrep job in the following CI providers, which are explicitly supported in Semgrep AppSec Platform
your development cycle benefits from the automated scanning of repositories at various events, such as: Push events; Pull requests or merge requests
Semgrep is integrated into CI environments by creating a **job** that is run by the CI provider.
